title: riskell extension manifest (riskell.json)
description: Describes one extension: a pill, a theme, a preset, or a compiled reading / atom / behaviour. `risk ext validate` enforces this file plus source rules the schema cannot express.

id.description: Unique, lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

license.description: An SPDX license identifier (https://spdx.org/licenses), or LicenseRef-… for a custom one.

kit.description: The RiskellKit versions it builds against, a SemVer range such as ^1.0.

module.description: The Swift module, which is also the name of the package's library product.

entry.description: The type in `module` that conforms to RiskellPackage.

atoms.description: The AtomMeta ids the package registers; placed in a layout as ext:<id>.

files.description: For pill, theme and preset: the files copied into ~/.config/riskell/.

preview.description: A path to a PNG shown in the registry.
